mission.dbtenkaichi.saiyan_saga_06_techn: Learn the Kaioken and the Spirit Bomb from King Kai.

race.dbtenkaichi.android.desc: Infinite energy reserve, impossible to sense.
race.dbtenkaichi.human.desc: Masters of technique: efficient Ki and fast training.
race.dbtenkaichi.namekian.desc: Regenerates with Ki and stretches limbs.
race.dbtenkaichi.saiyan.desc: Warrior race: Zenkai after near-death fights, hungry for battle, has a tail.
scene.dbtenkaichi.alliance.1: So you came. Have you brought me my hundred corpses?
scene.dbtenkaichi.alliance.2: Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not here to help you. I just want him gone.
scene.dbtenkaichi.alliance.3: Piccolo... for once we fight on the same side.
scene.dbtenkaichi.alliance.4: Two against one won't change a thing! My power level is fifteen hundred!
scene.dbtenkaichi.alliance.5: We'll see about that. Don't slow me down.
scene.dbtenkaichi.alliance.6: Let's go! We're getting Gohan back!
scene.dbtenkaichi.alliance.7: Come then! I'll crush you both!
scene.dbtenkaichi.beam_clash.4: Impossible! A low-class warrior overpowering me?!
scene.dbtenkaichi.beam_clash.5: Enough games... I'll show you the true power of a Saiyan!
scene.dbtenkaichi.bubbles_caught.1: Not bad at all! Your body is adapting to the gravity.
scene.dbtenkaichi.bubbles_caught.2: Next test: hit Gregory with this hammer.
scene.dbtenkaichi.epilogue.1: You're all back! ...Well, most of you.
scene.dbtenkaichi.epilogue.2: Piccolo, Yamcha, Tien, Chiaotzu... without Kami, there are no Dragon Balls to bring them back.
scene.dbtenkaichi.epilogue.3: Then we'll find another way. There's another set of Dragon Balls... on planet Namek!
scene.dbtenkaichi.epilogue.4: A journey into space, eh? You'd better rest up first.
scene.dbtenkaichi.epilogue.5: Namek... Wait for us. We'll bring everyone back.
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.1: Pathetic. Your little alliance ends here.
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.10: A year. I'll train the boy myself. As for you... you're finished.
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.11: Do not despair. I will ask King Yemma to let you train in the Other World.
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.12: Then... see you in a year. Take care of Gohan...
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.3: What?! The brat's power is over thirteen hundred!
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.4: Piccolo! I've got him! Do it now!
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.5: Let go of me! You'll die too, you fool!
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.6: Hold him still... just a little longer!
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.8: Fools... two more Saiyans are coming... far stronger than me...
scene.dbtenkaichi.gohan_rage.9: They'll arrive within a year... and this planet will be theirs...
scene.dbtenkaichi.goku_arrives.1: This ki... it's enormous! It's coming this way!
scene.dbtenkaichi.goku_arrives.3: Sorry I'm late. Leave the rest to me.
scene.dbtenkaichi.goku_arrives.4: What?! His power level... it's over eight thousand?!
scene.dbtenkaichi.goku_arrives.5: Over eight thousand?! The scouter must be broken!
scene.dbtenkaichi.goku_arrives.6: Nappa, you idiot. He can hide his ki. Be careful.
scene.dbtenkaichi.goku_arrives.7: You hurt my friends. Now you deal with me.
scene.dbtenkaichi.goku_arrives.8: Big talk! I'll crush you like a bug!
scene.dbtenkaichi.gregory_hit.1: Ouch! Okay, okay, you got me!
scene.dbtenkaichi.gregory_hit.2: Excellent! You're faster than you think. Now the real training begins.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_meeting.1: Whoa... my body feels so heavy here!
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_meeting.2: The gravity here is ten times the Earth's. Welcome to my planet!
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_meeting.3: So you want me to train you, eh? First... you have to make me laugh!
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_meeting.4: Uh... why did the Saiyan cross the road? To get to the other side!
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_meeting.5: Hahaha! That's terrible! I love it!
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_meeting.6: Alright. Your first test: catch my pet monkey, Bubbles.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_meeting.7: Once you can keep up with him in this gravity, we'll talk.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_training.1: First technique: the Kaioken. It multiplies your power by drawing out all your ki.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_training.2: Careful! Push it too far and it will tear your body apart.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_training.3: Now, my ultimate technique: the Spirit Bomb.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_training.4: Raise your hands. Gather energy from every living thing around you.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_training.5: Trees, animals, the air itself... borrow a little from each of them.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_training.6: Only a pure heart can wield it. Use it only as a last resort.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_training.7: Kaioken and Spirit Bomb... I won't let you down.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_kai_training.8: Practice both. The Saiyans won't wait for you!
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_yemma.1: So you're the one Kami spoke of. A warrior who fell protecting the Earth.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_yemma.2: Please, King Yemma. Let this warrior train with King Kai.
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_yemma.3: Snake Way is a million kilometres long. Nobody has ever made it to the end!
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_yemma.5: Ha! Follow the road to its tail and you'll find King Kai's planet. Don't fall off!
scene.dbtenkaichi.king_yemma.6: Hurry. The Saiyans will reach the Earth in less than a year.
scene.dbtenkaichi.nappa_end.1: It's over. Take your friend and leave this planet.
scene.dbtenkaichi.nappa_end.3: Vegeta... help me... I can't move...
scene.dbtenkaichi.nappa_end.4: A Saiyan who cannot move is useless to me.
scene.dbtenkaichi.nappa_end.5: You killed your own partner... You're a monster!
scene.dbtenkaichi.power_ball.1: Do you know what a Saiyan becomes under a full moon? Of course you don't.
scene.dbtenkaichi.power_ball.3: Burst open and mix! A Power Ball, the artificial moon!
scene.dbtenkaichi.power_ball.4: Now you will be crushed like an insect!
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.1: Hey! It's been ages! Come on in, everyone's here!
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.10: Then the boy comes with me. Bring me a hundred dead Earthlings by tomorrow if you want him back!
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.11: He took Gohan... That guy was way too strong!
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.2: Everyone, this is Gohan, my student. Say hello, Gohan.
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.3: He's adorable! So you're a teacher now?
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.4: Heh heh, a fine young pupil. He has strong eyes.
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.5: So this is where you've been hiding. The strongest fighter on this planet.
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.6: Who are you? What do you want?
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.7: I am Raditz, a Saiyan warrior. My race conquers planets... and I need strong fighters.
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.8: Join me. Or refuse... and see what happens to this boy.
scene.dbtenkaichi.reunion.9: I'll never join you! Leave Gohan out of this!
scene.dbtenkaichi.saiyans_land.1: So this is the planet. Nappa, plant the Saibamen. Let's have some fun.
scene.dbtenkaichi.saiyans_land.10: Three hours have passed. Your hero isn't coming. Nappa, finish them.
scene.dbtenkaichi.saiyans_land.2: Six Saibamen, ready to play. Come on, Earthlings!
scene.dbtenkaichi.saiyans_land.3: Yamcha!! Those monsters... You'll pay for that!
scene.dbtenkaichi.saiyans_land.5: Chiaotzu!! Tri-Beam... take everything I have left!!
scene.dbtenkaichi.saiyans_land.7: Gohan... these years with you... were the only good ones I had... Run...
scene.dbtenkaichi.saiyans_land.9: Hold on, everyone. Help is almost there!
scene.dbtenkaichi.tail_cut.1: Okay... nobody's looking... Tail, here I come!
scene.dbtenkaichi.tail_cut.10: I will not lose to scum like you!!
scene.dbtenkaichi.tail_cut.3: Everyone... lend me your energy. Just a little more...
scene.dbtenkaichi.tail_cut.4: Trees, oceans, everyone on Earth... please...
scene.dbtenkaichi.tail_cut.5: Krillin! I can't move! Throw it for me!
scene.dbtenkaichi.tail_cut.6: Got it! Here goes... Spirit Bomb!!
scene.dbtenkaichi.tail_cut.7: What is that?! I can't dodge it!
scene.dbtenkaichi.tail_cut.9: Impossible... me... the Prince of all Saiyans...
scene.dbtenkaichi.title.techniques: New techniques learned: Kaioken, Spirit Bomb
scene.dbtenkaichi.vegeta_escapes.2: The brat still has his tail?! Curses!
scene.dbtenkaichi.vegeta_escapes.3: My body... I can't... I need my pod...
scene.dbtenkaichi.vegeta_escapes.4: Now's my chance! I'll finish him with Yajirobe's sword!
scene.dbtenkaichi.vegeta_escapes.6: You'll regret sparing me... Next time, this planet will be mine!
scene.dbtenkaichi.wish.1: The Dragon Balls have been gathered! They're wishing you back to life!
scene.dbtenkaichi.wish.2: Your halo is gone. Go! Snake Way leads back to the check-in station.
scene.dbtenkaichi.wish.3: Thank you for everything, King Kai!
scene.dbtenkaichi.wish.4: The Saiyans have already landed. Your friends are fighting right now!
